title: CallbackClaimV1
description: THE single source of truth for where + how mesh delivers the RESULT of a dispatched unit of work back to the requesting customer. Paired with dispatch-request.schema.json. Replaces the English-prose webhook instruction ('POST to {webhookUrl} with Bearer $SITELAYER_CHAT_WEBHOOK_TOKEN') that lived in LLM prompt builders: mesh STORES this claim and EXECUTES the callback itself, deterministically, with a mesh-minted scoped token. The token is a REFERENCE (token_ref), never a literal env-var name and never the secret value — no secret material crosses this contract. auth_scheme unifies the two divergent legacy auth shapes into one enum. additionalProperties:false. The TypeScript interface in src/callback-claim.ts mirrors this schema field-for-field (a contract test enforces sync).

schema_version.description: Claim schema version. The single declared version; bumped only on a breaking change.

callback_url.description: Absolute URL mesh delivers the work result to. Required — nothing to execute without it.

auth_scheme.description: How mesh authenticates the callback. Unifies the two legacy auth shapes; 'scoped_bearer' is the default. Required so auth is never implicit.

token_ref.description: Mesh-minted REFERENCE to the credential (key id / secret-store handle), NOT a literal env-var name and NOT the secret value. Resolved by mesh at call time. Omitted/null when auth_scheme is 'none'.

method.description: HTTP method for the callback. Defaults to 'POST'.

expected_status.description: HTTP status codes mesh treats as successful delivery. Anything else is a failed attempt subject to retry. Defaults to [200, 201, 202, 204].

response_body_schema_ref.description: Optional reference ($id / registry key) to the JSON schema describing the expected response body, so a delivery can be validated, not just status-checked. A reference — the schema itself lives in a registry, not inline.

max_attempts.description: Maximum delivery attempts (initial try + retries) before mesh marks the callback failed. Defaults to a mesh-side policy when omitted.
